maddeler.e:
انتهجن (form VII)
# اِنْتَهَجْنَ (intahajna) /in.ta.had͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# اُنْتُهِجْنَ (untuhijna) /un.tu.hid͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# اِنْتَهِجْنَ (intahijna) /in.ta.hid͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
